data.gender_notes: Abramo is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Abram means 'father of a multitude.' This name was given to Abraham, the patriarch of the Hebrew people, when God made a covenant with him and promised to make him the father of many nations. The name Abramo carries the meaning “Father of a multitude” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Abramo usually hope their child will grow to embody father of a multitude and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Abramo belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Father of a multitude.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Abramo total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: אברהמו
in_hebrew.meaning: אב הרם, אב רם, גבוה, מרומם
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם אברהמו נגזר משורש עבר, רם או הרם, שפירושו גבוה או מרומם. בהקשר המקראי, השם מתייחס לאברהם, האב של עם ישראל, שזכה למעמד גבוה ולקרבה אל האל. השם משקף את מעמדו הרם ואת תפקידו כמנהיג רוחני.

in_greek.name: Αβραμο
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Αβραμο προέρχεται από το εβραϊκό όνομα אברהמו, που σημαίνει υψηλός ή ανώτατος. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, το όνομα συνδέεται με τον Αβραάμ, τον πατέρα του έθνους Ισραήλ, που είχε υψηλή θέση στην θρησκευτική παράδοση. Το όνομα αντανακλά την πνευματική του σημασία και την ηγετική του θέση.

in_latin.name: Abramo
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Abramo is derived from the Hebrew root עבר, meaning to be high or exalted. In the Christian tradition, the name Abramo is associated with Abraham, the father of the faithful, who held a high spiritual position. The name reflects his elevated status and leadership role in the biblical narrative.

in_english.name: Abramo
in_english.meaning: Exalted father, elevated one, spiritual leader
in_english.long_meaning: The name Abramo originates from the Hebrew name אברהמו, meaning 'exalted father' or 'high one'. In the biblical context, Abramo is linked to Abraham, the patriarch of the Israelites, who enjoyed a high spiritual status. The name signifies his elevated position, leadership, and spiritual significance in the Christian tradition. It conveys qualities of strength, wisdom, and faith.

data.cultural_impact: ** Abram is the name of the patriarch Abraham in the Hebrew Bible, who is considered the founder of the Jewish, Christian, and Islamic faiths. His faithful response to God's call led him to leave his homeland and venture into the unknown, becoming the parent of many nations. The name Abram has continued to be used in various cultures, especially in Italy, as a given name. It is a reminder of the importance of faith, obedience, and being open to new experiences.
data.spiritual_significance: ** In the Hebrew Bible, the name Abram was changed to Abraham, which means 'father of many,' reflecting the promise God made to him that he would be the father of a vast multitude. This spiritual significance serves as a reminder of God's faithfulness and the blessings that come from trusting in Him. It also highlights the concept of becoming a father figure not just biologically, but spiritually and metaphorically, helping others grow and multiply.
